Native KKS state supplies the complete beat:step:pulse coordinate, one hand with its step label and percentIntoStep fill, and continuous day-progress sweep. The user explicitly requested removing all solar/reference hand logic, controls and location acquisition from Bankeiz. Authorized presentation refinements enlarge and rebalance the dial on matte navy, add neutral material depth, inherit Bankeiz Inter/sans typography, and relocate supplemental readouts and consistent ark captions below. authorizedSurfacePalette: The user explicitly authorized deeper muted tones for all presentation colors. BANK_KAI_PALETTE maps ark/day/month/week categories to coordinated light/dark Bankeiz tones; the original category names, indices and canonical hex metadata remain separately preserved in kai-klok.ts. pulseMotion: The orb makes one bounded linear compositor revolution per native eternal pulse. The same held KaiTimeSource is resampled after animation creation; native μpulse phase and the native subdivision period seed both orb and a <=0.15% material-only inhale/exhale. Each native boundary/open/foreground resume reseeds them; hidden/reduced-motion state cancels them. Browser frame scheduling limits visual simultaneity; no second clock, RAF loop, physiological claim, or accumulated CSS period is introduced.
localChronos: Automatic device-timezone formatting of the displayed native whole-pulse boundary remains for orientation. It creates no separate hand, temporal anchor or location requirement.
